-For the patients cervical radiculopathy: Recommend Cervical C7/T1 interlaminar epidural steroid injection.
Professional fees are approximately $8,000. If performed in a surgical center then fees are approximately $15,000.
-As an alternative to injection therapy, the patient is also a candidate for 4 sessions of cervical and 4 sessions of
lumbar Biowave percutaneous electrical nerve stimulation (PENS) for amplified pain. BioWave PENS is a FDA cleared
device for treatment of nociceptive and neuropathic pain including painful spinal and joint conditions. The PENS
(percutaneous electrical nerve stimulation) modality uses a patented sterile, single use, array of needles inserted
through the skin to facilitate delivery of therapeutic signals into deep tissue. Treatment sessions are 30, minutes
each, and must be performed in a physician's office, for a total of 4 treatment sessions per area, typically over 2 to 4
weeks. Medical expenses are $1500 per treatment session.
-As an alternative to pain management procedures, Intermittent Disc Decompression (IDD) therapy was discussed in
detail with the patient as a conservative approach in the management of the spinal injuries. This technology provides
non-invasive treatment for spine discogenic pain. The protocol treatment includes 20 sessions of 30 minutes each
over the course of six weeks. The estimated cost is $15,000.
